brief.title: Accounts Payable Clerk

company.name: Mzansi Logistics
company.about: We move freight for 400 retailers across Gauteng and KwaZulu-Natal. Our finance team of nine keeps 1,200 suppliers paid on time.

brief.purpose: Own the supplier payment cycle for the Durban depot so suppliers are paid on time and the creditors book stays clean.
success_measures: Weekly payment run ready for approval every Thursday
responsibilities: Capture and match about 300 supplier invoices a week against purchase orders in Sage
Prepare the weekly payment run for the Finance Supervisor to approve
Reconcile 40 supplier statements each month and resolve queries with buyers

must_have.text: Two or more years in an accounts payable or creditors role
Working knowledge of Sage or a similar accounting package
must_have.justification: all invoice capture happens in Sage

must_have: Comfortable with Excel lookups and pivot tables

pay.basis: years of creditors experience and Sage proficiency

benefits: Transport allowance of R1,500 a month

process.steps: A 30-minute phone screen, then one on-site interview with the Finance Supervisor and a short Excel exercise. Everyone hears back within three weeks.

statements.ee: Mzansi Logistics is a designated employer. Preference will be given to candidates from designated groups in line with our Employment Equity plan.
statements.popia: We process your personal information under POPIA only for this recruitment.
statements.accessibility: If you need any accommodation during the application process, tell us and we will arrange it.
